kurz: Sourdough is a culture of wild yeasts and lactic acid bacteria. It makes bread rise and gives it acidity and depth.
bild_im_kopf: Like a little garden in a jar that you feed regularly.
was_passiert: Flour and water, fed regularly, are colonised by yeasts and bacteria from the flour and the surroundings. An active sourdough bubbles, smells pleasantly sour and grows clearly after feeding.
faustregeln: Use it when it is at its highest after feeding.
Keep it in the fridge and refresh it before baking.
